### Added
- **A Responses API ModelConfig for codex through the LLM listener** (giantswarm/giantswarm#38551). The codex runtime speaks OpenAI's Responses API only, and the listener's ModelConfigs followed the first `llmRouting.models` entry's provider alone, so a codex agent's model calls went to the provider directly, unpriced and outside the rate limits. Every `llmRouting.models` provider now rides the listener: an `OpenAI` entry (`baseURL: https://api.openai.com/v1`, `match: gpt-*`) serves the Responses route the data plane classifies at `/v1/responses`, and a `kagent.modelConfigs[]` entry of that provider gets the listener URL with `/v1`, the base an OpenAI client appends `/responses` to. A new `apiFormat` key (`chatCompletions` or `responses`, OpenAI only, refused elsewhere naming the entry) sets `openAI.apiFormat`; with `responses` and no other OpenAI option the ModelConfig passes the codex compiler's rules. The MutatingAdmissionPolicy renders once per served provider, so a codex ModelConfig agent-manager or Backstage creates rides the listener too (`<release>-modelconfig-llm-routing-openai`; the first provider's keeps its name). `llmRouting.rateLimits` target the listener, so they cover the Responses route as every other. A codex call appears under its agent in the usage metrics once the codex runtime names its agent on its model calls (giantswarm/kagent-upstream#613); until then it reads `unknown`. `make verify-llm-routing`.
